forge_interview.product_idea: A minimal example product to exercise the Forge orchestration lifecycle end to end.
forge_interview.primary_user: A developer (and an operator) running the core workflow.
forge_interview.core_outcome: Bootstrap a project and run the core workflow end to end; view system health.
forge_interview.constraints: Keep it compact — a single CLI entrypoint over a single relational store.

features.name: Feature 1 — core workflow
features.answer: Users can bootstrap a project and run the core workflow end to end.

features.name: Feature 2 — health dashboard
features.answer: Operators can view a dashboard of system health.

draft_spec.stack_choice: Single CLI entrypoint; subcommands added per phase. Persistence is a single relational store, versioned via migrations.
